name: aside
description: /aside <question> asks a quick side question over your current context and shows the answer in a pane, without adding anything to the conversation.

enabled.title: Enable /aside
enabled.description: Turn off to make /aside and the word aside do nothing (no side question is ever sent).

maxAnswerChars.title: Longest answer kept (characters)
maxAnswerChars.description: An answer longer than this is cut and says so.
